VCS New England provides the best cancer care for your best friend, to help you get back to what matters.
Treating cancer, easing stress
We want to give you a few less things to worry about. At VCS New England, you can expect:
An intimate, personalized experience, every visit
One family in the building at a time
No cages or stressful drop-offs/pickups
An exceptional, loving staff who all know you
Thoughtful consultations and expert, compassionate care

Our Philosophy
We love our cats and dogs, just like you do
At VCS New England, we’re dedicated to creating the best quality of life for your pet for as long as possible. It starts with meeting you where you are—answering your questions and listening to your hopes and fears. Then we’ll help you understand the prognosis, explain the treatment options, and move forward in whatever way works best for your family.
Dr. Andy Abbo
DVM MS DACVIM—Oncology
Dr. Abbo believes the best cancer treatment for your cat or dog is the one that is tailored to your family’s goals. Learn more about taking on cancer.
